This research explores the rational considerations behind individuals’ self-diagnosis and self-medication practices. Our main objective is to find out the frequency of self-diagnosis and self-medication in the general population and its associated risks and benefits.Methods:A cross-sectional community-based prospective study was conducted over 7 months and included 160 students from various nonmedical universities in Karachi.
